findings.title: The house family's inline_styles declaration omits generate_engine_pages.py's GRAPH_CSS used by render_backlog(), so the library's INLINE_STYLES auto-fill silently produces the batch-graph page without ~876 bytes of real CSS; the replay test covers only the bare _page() path while OPS-033 and templates/README.md claim 'the engine pages'.
findings.evidence: templates/html/library.yaml:321-332; tools/generate_engine_pages.py _page() ~1203 extra_styles; live check: matches real page? False, 9448 vs 10324 bytes, GRAPH_CSS absent.
findings.consequence: No current generator depends on the library, and house byte-identity is outside the stated acceptance, but a near-future phase trusting the auto-fill would ship a broken page silently.
findings.minimal_fix: Declare the graph page's CSS (files entry or per-template inline_styles override), or narrow OPS-033/README's 'the engine pages' claim to the tested path, and add a test replaying render_backlog()'s fill.
